primitives.meaning: a moment where an advocacy request would be contextually sensible, against a relationship with positive evidence behind it
entryFilters: a moment where an advocacy request would be contextually sensible, against a relationship with positive evidence behind it
no instance of this journey is already open for the person or account plus the relationship context the advocacy would be about
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.asks: Is there an open negative issue anywhere in this relationship?

branches.label: Something open
branches.test: an unresolved complaint, issue or dispute exists

primitives.reEntry: resolution makes this eligible again - and a recovery that then held is itself strong evidence, so the wait is not lost

primitives.does: Weigh the accumulated positive evidence: outcomes actually achieved, value realised repeatedly, positive feedback, meaningful tenure, a recovery that afterwards held, contributions offered without being asked. The set is what matters, not the most recent item in it

primitives.asks: Is the evidence sufficient to justify asking?

branches.label: Sufficient
branches.test: the relationship carries enough independent positive evidence to bear a request

branches.label: Not yet
branches.test: the evidence is real but thin - a good experience is not yet a relationship

primitives.state: not yet eligible; evidence may accumulate
primitives.reEntry: further positive evidence re-opens this without anything having to be undone

primitives.asks: What size of request does this evidence support?

branches.label: Low commitment
branches.test: a rating or a review - a few minutes, their words, their choice of where

branches.label: High commitment
branches.test: a testimonial, a case study, a reference call - their name and reputation attached to ours, and usually reusable

competition.precedence: policy orders satisfaction and advocacy asks against each other; neither is assumed to outrank the other

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message has to be kept and survive until the person can act on it
the person is active in the product and the action is taken there
a valid token or app session exists and the message is a single step from the notification

primitives.purpose: Make the small ask, once, with no follow-up sequence behind it.
primitives.brief: Make the small ask, once, with no follow-up sequence behind it. A rating or a one-tap response can go wherever the person already is, including an interruptive route where permission for one exists

primitives.purpose: Make the substantial ask on a durable, reviewable route, stating plainly what would be used, where, and that agreeing to contribute is separate from agreeing to publication - because it is, and discovering that later is how a supporter becomes a complaint.
primitives.brief: Make the substantial ask on a durable, reviewable route, stating plainly what would be used, where, and that agreeing to contribute is separate from agreeing to publication - because it is, and discovering that later is how a supporter becomes a complaint. A request that attaches somebody's name and reputation to the organisation is not an interruption to be tapped past; it needs somewhere they can read it twice

mustNotClaim: that contributing is permission to publish

primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: the requested advocacy action is recorded as done

primitives.reads: the person or account plus the relationship context the advocacy would be about re-read from the system of record before acting on the timeout

branches.label: Contributed, for public reuse
branches.test: they provided something we intend to publish, quote or reference

branches.label: Contributed, no public reuse
branches.test: they provided something that stays internal

primitives.on: an intention to publicly reuse something someone contributed
carries: what would be used, where, and for how long - which is the scope the permission has to cover
the contribution itself, held unpublished until that permission exists

primitives.reEntry: any later intention to publish it is a new permission question, not an extension of this one
materially stronger evidence after the cooldown may justify a different request; the same one is not repeated
silence on a favour is not a decline and not a signal about the relationship - it is simply not an answer
